0022600166.text: The Timberwolves (4-3, 9th in the West, 4-3 in their last ten) host the Milwaukee Bucks (1-5, 14th in the East, on a two-game losing streak) in Minnesota's eighth game of the season. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Rudy Gobert (out, back spasms). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Timberwolves won both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
